bagPolicy.summary: The Luke Combs concert guidance allowed clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear zip bags and clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Medical equipment was subject to extra screening; all bags were inspected.
